hook: Your dream feels too big to start.
override.tagline:
Turn your dream into
a plan you can see.

script: Your dream feels too big to start, right? || So shrink it. Write down the vision, and give it a date. || Then add three milestones that show you're getting there. || Now take one of them, and break it into small actions. Like sending five proposals, posting one project, following up. || You don't need motivation for that. You just need one thing, done today. || And then you watch it grow. || That's Dmyor.
